test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

If P + K - R + J ÷ M × T + Z, then which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: K is the father of M.
R is the daughter of T.
P is the mother of J
Z is the father of J.

solution:
The symbols and their meaning used in the family tree is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749b5b689090c8a303af7be8d3e16c0fd60e1068fd8dc460dddfc628895fff49.png] 

According to the given statement P + K - R + J ÷ M × T + Z we have the family tree as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96a84850ecd0b1918a8f4b2f4aff1a56f068d1df62bc348435180d005be3b870.png] 

Thus, **Z is father of J** is correct statement.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'
